rows.text: The party's text dated 20 November 2000 gives the opening address of the 22nd Congress delivered by 不破哲三委員長 ('日本共産党第２２回大会で、不破哲三委員長がおこなった開会あいさつ').

Congress and plenum elections, in-office attestations, withdrawals, honorary offices, rule procedure, suspensions, acting service, the earlier 国民民主党 of 2018-2020 and its offices, and organization events stay separate rows; holder boundaries are decided in the packet, not by any row.
